title: He took apart his first computer and learned to code. He was eight.
caption:
He took apart his first computer and learned to code. He was eight.

He came out to his whole high school, dropped out of Stanford, and worked so hard on his first startup he got scurvy. It still failed.

His father died in 2018. In 2023 his own board fired him, saying he wasn't consistently candid. Nearly all his staff threatened to quit, and he was back within days.

That kid is Sam Altman. Forbes puts his net worth at $3.2B.

Which part of his story surprised you most?
